sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
ஆறு படை வீடெதற்கு ஆறுமுகமெதற்கு
ஆறு எழுத்து மந்திரந்தான் எதற்கு
sections.translit:
ARupadai vIdedhaRku ARumugamedhaRku
Aru ezhutthu mandhiranthAn edhaRku
sections.en: Why do you need six dwelling places, Muruga? Why do you need six faces? Why do you need a divine chant with six syllables?

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
கூறுமென் குறை கேட்டு தீருமுன் கலியென்று
ஆறுதல் சொன்னவன் மாறுதல் மதியோ
sections.translit:
kURumen kuRai kEttu thIrumun kaliyendRu
ARudhal sonnavan mARudhal madhiyO
sections.en: You listened to my numerous entreaties about my predicament. You offered consolation that all my suffering will come to an end soon. Is it wise for you to change your mind now?

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
சேறான வாழ்வுதனில் சோராத நினைவினிலே
நேராக நடந்தாலும் மாறாத வினைப்பயனாய்
தேராத நட்பினால் தீராத துயர் அடைந்தேன்
ஏறாத மலையில்லை வாராததேனோ வடிவேலா
sections.translit:
sERAna vAzhvudhanil sOrAdha ninaivinilE
nErAga nadandhAlum mARAdha vinaippayanAy
thErAdha natpinAl thIrAdha thuyar adaindhEn
ERAdha malaiyillai vArAdhadhEnO vadivElA
sections.en: I walk without fatigue, thinking of you constantly in this muddied life. However, I suffer without an end in sight because of bad relationships, bound by my unalterable destiny. I have climbed every hill in search of you. Oh Lord Vadivela, why have you not come to my aid?

notes: The six abodes of Muruga, referred to as ஆறுபடை வீடுகள் (ARupadai vIdugaL), are located on hilltops in the following places: Tiruparangkundram, Tiruchendur, Pazhani, Swamimalai, Tiruththani, and Pazhamudhircholai. More details regarding these sacred shrines can be found in: Arupadai Vidugal Lord Muruga is worshipped with the six syllable mantra Sa - Ra -Va - Na - Bha -Va (Saravanabhava). Each syllable has its own significance in relation to the Lord's grace in one’s life. There are different versions of the mantra’s meanings. For a description, see: Meaning of Saravanabhava
